description: A copy-paste sign-up page built from the SvGrid UI kit in Svelte 5: a centred SvCard with two-up name fields, a work email, a password with the live strength meter, a plan SvSegmented switch and a terms SvCheckBox, a submit SvButton that shows loading and stays disabled until the form is valid, and a benefits rail beside the card. Submit fires a promise toast.

faq.question: How is the submit button gated?
faq.answer: canSubmit is a $derived requiring a name, an email, a password of at least eight characters and the terms box; the button reads it as disabled and shows loading while the promise runs.

faq.question: How is the plan chosen?
faq.answer: SvSegmented with block width lists the plans as mutually exclusive segments bound to plan, which goes into the submitted payload.

faq.question: Can I reuse the benefits rail?
faq.answer: Yes. It is an SvList with type none and check icons inside a stack; edit the items or drop the rail for a single-column page.
